goal: Decide if a declaration uses only the axioms its source allows. Then lexlean verify publishes nothing that rests on more.

app.name: lexlean-axiom-policy
app.title: Axiom policy
app.purpose: Decide, for one declaration at stage 11 of lexlean verify, whether its axiom audit permits it, denies it with LLV7005, does not apply to it, or cannot be decided, from the audit result, where the declaration lives, its policy kind and how its observed set differs from the declared list.
limits: It does not run the audit: the observed set is read from the Lean axiom audit members of stage 9 and 10.
It does not judge a model declaration's generated family, whose union LexLean compares with the model's declared set separately.

fields.name: audit
fields.means: the audit of the declaration: listed in the output, absent from it, its member exited nonzero, or its output refused by the parser

fields.name: row
fields.means: a source declaration of a document, or a row of the document's core calculus

fields.name: policy
fields.means: the declared AxiomPolicy: noaxioms, allowaxioms or exactaxioms

fields.name: outside
fields.means: observed axioms not in the declared list (for noaxioms, every observed axiom)

fields.name: unseen
fields.means: declared axioms the audit did not observe

meanings.permit: XACML 3.0 Permit: the observed set satisfies the policy and the declaration row records result ok
meanings.deny: XACML 3.0 Deny: the observed set violates the policy and verify fails with LLV7005
meanings.not-applicable: XACML 3.0 NotApplicable: no observation applies, so the policy is not enforced on this row
meanings.indeterminate: XACML 3.0 Indeterminate: the audit could not be evaluated, so verify fails before any policy is judged

rules.why: crates/lexlean/src/verify/mod.rs: an audit member that exits nonzero fails with LLV7004
verify/mod.rs: output that axiom::parse_audit_output refuses fails with LLV7004, missing or malformed audit output
verify/mod.rs stage 11: a core declaration absent from the observed map is skipped (continue)
verify/mod.rs: the audit family must observe every declaration, or verify fails as an internal error
ir/declaration.rs AxiomPolicy::permits: none needs an empty set, allow a subset, exact an equal one
AxiomPolicy::permits Exact: the sorted, deduplicated observed set must equal the declared list

app.otherwiseWhy: AxiomPolicy::permits: every observed axiom is declared, and an exact policy saw every declared one

properties.why: an axiom the source did not declare is never published
an exact policy is equality, not a subset (SPEC section 15.9)
a failed audit proves nothing about the declaration
output the parser refuses proves nothing about the declaration
a source declaration the audit missed is never taken as axiom free
an observed set equal to the declared list satisfies all three policies

stakeholders.name: Model author
stakeholders.text: Pins each declaration's axioms with noaxioms, allowaxioms or exactaxioms and needs verify to hold the kernel to exactly that.

stakeholders.name: Release reviewer
stakeholders.text: Reads the declaration rows of a verify before a release and needs no row to say ok unless its audit was read and satisfied.

concerns.name: No unaudited permit
concerns.text: A declaration whose audit failed, was refused or missed it is never permitted.

components.name: Lean axiom audit
components.text: The audit modules lexlean verify runs under the pinned Lean, whose output lists the axioms each declaration depends on.

components.name: lexlean verify
components.text: The LexLean verifier whose stage 11 enforces each declaration's policy and writes the declaration rows.

threats.name: Classical axiom slipped in
threats.text: A declaration pinned noaxioms or an exact set starts depending on Classical.choice through a lemma it uses, and is still reported ok.

control.name: Observed set outside the policy is denied
control.text: Any observed axiom outside the declared list is a deny, proved for every request.

threats.name: Silent audit taken as clean
threats.text: An audit member crashes or prints nothing for a declaration, and an empty observed set is read as no axioms.

control.name: No permit without an audit
control.text: A failed, refused or missing audit of a source declaration is indeterminate, never permit.

threats.name: Core row left unenforced
threats.text: A core-calculus row absent from the audit is skipped, so a policy on it is never enforced.
threats.accepted: verify/mod.rs skips a core row the audit does not name by design: only the declarations the audit family observes carry an observed set, and the not-applicable answer says so.

quality.text: No request with an undeclared observed axiom, or an exact policy missing one, is permitted.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors permitted while outside or, under exact, unseen is at least 1.

quality.text: Each vector answers the decision stage 11 of lexlean verify reaches.
quality.measureText: Acceptance vectors whose replayed answer differs from the expected decision.
